response.text: Dominion Energy South Carolina and Georgia (SAV) have planned line rebuild projects located 0.84 miles apart. Dominion plans to rebuild the St George - Sumter 230kV Tie for grid hardening at a cost of 4000000 between 2024-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Georgia (SAV) plans to rebuild 9.3 miles of the Goshen - Kraft 115kV line between 2024-06-01 and 2027-06-01. Because their construction windows overlap concurrently with a time gap of 517 days, there is a high opportunity to share crews, equipment and cranes, staging/laydown yards, and outage coordination.
